title: Redleaf
tagline: Shadow's Ascent · climb, cut, and claim the summit blade
description: A red-lacquer handheld platformer. Run Shadow up the Redleaf forest trail, cut brush for silver, jump the stone steps to shrine caches, slip through lantern-lit tunnels as a silhouette, then climb Windbreak Mountain and pull the Windcleaver from the summit. Spend saved silver at the Silver Shrine.
credit: Game by Jerm747. Shadow from GS Fighter.
